newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines says forex reserves hit $12.03 bln.
newsitem.headline: Philippines says forex reserves hit $12.03 bln.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Tuesday its gross international reserves hit a record $12.03 billion as of January 6.
The reserves stood at $11.8 billion by the end of last year and $7.7 billion as of end-1995.

"The increase is attributed to the strong inflows from overseas Filipino professionals and contract workers as well as offshore fund managers who continue to manifest confidence in the country's strong economic fundamentals," the bank said in a statement.
The reserve was approximately equivalent to 3.1 months worth of imports, it said.
